concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII mandates 'a strict separation between the training set (80%) and the held-out test set (20%)... ensuring that no samples from the same experimental batch or source study appear in both sets.' No task creates a group-aware 80/20 held-out split or performs a final held-out evaluation; T004/T005 only implement 5-fold GroupKFold CV. Add a task (e.g. in T004 or T005) producing the group-aware 80/20 split and reporting final held-out R²/RMSE, or the constitution requirement is uncovered.

The constitution requires 'A requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at projects/.../code/ pins every Python dependency' and that every script runs in an isolated venv built from it. No task creates or verifies this file; the plan only lists versions in Technical Context. Add a setup task (natural home: T001) writing code/requirements.txt with the pinned versions.

concerns.location: tasks.md:all tasks vs plan.md:Project Structure / quickstart.md
concerns.text: The plan's Project Structure lists quickstart.md as a deliverable and T004/T012 both verify against 'the documented command in the feature's quickstart.md', but no task writes quickstart.md. Add a task (or extend T004) to author quickstart.md with the single end-to-end command.

T007 tags SC-005 for the SHAP driver ranking, but SC-005 is the Jaccard-stability criterion delivered by T008. Stale/misapplied traceability tag — the driver-ranking output traces to FR-004/FR-005 content only.

Plan Phase 5 saves figures under 'outputs/figures/' and Phase 7 assembles 'report.md', while T007/T010 write to 'figures/' and 'data/results/summary_tables.md'. Same deliverables, divergent paths — an implementer following the plan will not satisfy the task verification paths. Unify (the tasks' paths are fine; the plan should match).
